reviewNotes: HOLD. HOT Mobile's HOTALK prepaid family remains current, and multiple current Israeli recharge retailers independently list a 66 ILS pay-per-use balance load valid for 180 days. However, a current first-party HOT Mobile page confirming that 180-day balance validity as the number-retention/deactivation lifecycle was not located. The legacy blanket no-KYC claim is withdrawn as unverified. Preserve the 66 ILS/180-day commercial signal without presenting it as a provider-verified keep-number rule.

events.outcome: Current Israeli recharge retailers consistently advertise a HOTALK 66 ILS pay-per-use balance load with 180-day validity, but current first-party evidence tying that balance validity to the phone-number deactivation/recycling lifecycle was not located. The legacy no-KYC claim is also withdrawn as unverified.

data.acquisitionSummary: HOT Mobile's HOTALK prepaid family remains available. Current local reseller channels sell new HOTALK SIMs and recharge products, but provider-native online acquisition/eSIM availability and foreign-user onboarding are not established by the evidence used here.

keep.action: Multiple current Israeli recharge retailers list a 66 ILS HOTALK pay-per-use balance load valid for 180 days. Preserve this as balance-validity evidence only; a provider-verified number-retention/deactivation interval is not established.

data.chinaActivation: Israel-side acquisition/onboarding is the only currently supported assumption. China-first activation is unverified.
data.kyc: The legacy blanket claim that Israeli prepaid requires no KYC is withdrawn. Current HOTALK identification requirements for a foreign buyer remain unverified in this review.
data.payment: Current local recharge resellers support online HOTALK loads; provider-native minimum recharge and foreign-card acceptance are unverified.
data.roamingSms: HOT Mobile offers roaming services generally, but HOTALK China-specific incoming SMS/OTP behavior is unverified.
data.holdReason: The 66 ILS/180-day balance-validity mechanic is corroborated by current local recharge retailers, but a current HOT Mobile first-party number-deactivation/recycling rule and foreign-user identification flow were not located.
data.tariffSummary: Current reseller signal: 66 ILS pay-per-use balance valid 180 days; number-lifecycle and KYC remain unresolved.
guideSteps: Treat current HOTALK availability as established, but verify the buyer/identification path before acquisition.
Do not equate the retailer-advertised 180-day balance validity with provider-confirmed number retention.
Re-open for admission when HOT Mobile publishes a current number lifecycle or a strong recent end-to-end reproduction establishes the retention rule.
